submitted.rationale: Index 7 (Ag 0.753, the Ag3VO4 composition) gave the highest measured photocurrent, 21.5 µA. MACE puts Ag3VO4 near the convex hull, and it is a known visible-light photoanode. The Ag-rich neighbour, index 0, came out slightly lower at 20.2 µA, so the maximum is likely near Ag 0.75–0.8.

rejected.reason: AgVO3 region (Ag 0.49) measured only 0.51 µA, about 40x lower.
Ag 0.82 measured 20.2 µA, slightly below index 7.
Photocurrent fell steeply as V increased, so these were not prioritised.

consultations.verdict: Support: MACE puts Ag3VO4 (Ag 0.75) near hull (0.023 eV/atom), so index 7 (Ag 0.753) should form this phase. MEGNet HSE gap 0.008 eV is implausible vs experimental ~2.2 eV, so treated as uninformative; AgVO3 gap 2.9 eV is below 3.22 eV photon energy too. Ag3VO4 is a known visible-light photoanode.

Support for exploring: AgVO3 (Ag 0.5) is near hull per MACE (0.012 eV/atom) and MEGNet HSE gap ~2.97 eV is below the 3.22 eV photon energy, so it can absorb. Index 4 (Ag 0.49) probes this distinct phase region vs the Ag3VO4 point already measured.

Moderate support: MACE puts Ag4VO4 (Ag 0.8) near hull (0.017 eV/atom), so the Ag 0.82 region should be Ag3VO4/Ag-rich vanadate, the phase family that gave 21.5 µA at index 7 versus 0.5 µA for AgVO3. Measured trend rises with Ag and GP mean is highest at index 0.
